ANON-4471.tagline: no names. no faces. no refunds.
ANON-4471.about: A handle that has posted work on the network for nine years and never once said why. Pays on time. Does not haggle well and does not like to be asked.

VENN.tagline: where two circles meet, there is a door.
VENN.about: Riddles in the copy, precise in the brief. VENN's jobs always overlap two companies, and VENN is always standing in the overlap.

M. HALLORAN.about: A solicitor with no practice certificate and a great many clients. The paperwork always needs a small correction somewhere it should not be.

THE COMMITTEE.tagline: minutes of the meeting are not kept.
THE COMMITTEE.about: Nobody knows who sits on it. Every job arrives as a numbered agenda item and every fee was set by a vote. Votes are rarely reopened.

OCTANT LTD.tagline: solutions. at scale. off the books.
OCTANT LTD.about: A shell company with a glossy front page and a quarterly budget for things it cannot write down. Will pay more for speed, never for attitude.

PRIVATE CLIENT.about: One-off customers brokered through a blind drop. Nervous, in a hurry, and often willing to pay a little more to stop worrying.

SOUTHBANK PARTNERS.about: A fund that moves money nobody can see. Haggles like a trader: respects a firm number, despises a greedy one.

retrieve.blurb: Somebody has a file. Somebody else wants it. Bring it home.

delete.name: SCRUBBERS
delete.blurb: Make it so it never existed. Leave nothing but a gap.

modify.name: PAPERWORK
modify.blurb: Records, rewritten. A death, a pardon, a promotion.

transfer.name: MONEY MOVES
transfer.blurb: Funds that wander from one ledger into another.

destroy.name: BURN BOOK
destroy.blurb: Total loss. Every file, every log, every trace.

model.name: MIND THEFT
model.blurb: Trained models walk out of the lab in your pocket.
